lines.text: This woman cannot stop dancing. And it is about to spread.
Strasbourg, July 1518. Frau Troffea dances in the street, for days.
lines.say: Strasbourg, July fifteen eighteen. Frow Troffaya dances in the street, for days.

lines.text: Within days, more than thirty people have joined her.
The doctors blame overheated blood. Their cure? More dancing.
So the city builds a stage, and hires musicians.
It backfires. By August, as many as four hundred are dancing.
Some may have danced themselves to death. Nobody knows how many.
At last the council bans dancing, and sends the dancers to a shrine of Saint Vitus.
Why? One historian blames mass stress, after famine and disease. Nobody knows for sure.
